Preparation and requirements

Prepare against the right standard.

Aerobridge teaches aviation knowledge and English skills that can be used internationally, with separate country guidance where available. The first local pack covers DGAC Chile.

ICAO Aviation English

The available course develops speaking and listening across the six ICAO language proficiency descriptors.

  • Pronunciation
  • Structure
  • Vocabulary
  • Fluency
  • Comprehension
  • Interaction
Level 4 is the minimum operational proficiency level.

Your authority decides which tests it accepts and how long results remain valid.

Pilot Licence Theory

Study the core subjects behind pilot licence theory: rules of the air, aircraft knowledge, performance, navigation and operations. DGAC references are included for Chile.

Two United States reference modules are included for context, but this is not an FAA exam-preparation course.

Practice formats

Aviation English exercises follow common oral assessment flows. Scorecards provide practice feedback only. They do not analyse recorded audio or produce an official rating.

A note on certification

Aerobridge supports study and practice. Licences and official language ratings are issued by the relevant authority or approved provider.
